title: How to Make Crispy Chicken Tenders on a Reusable Grill Mat
keyword: crispy chicken tenders on a grill mat
meta_description: Learn how to make perfectly crispy chicken tenders on a grill mat, using reusable BBQ Grill Mats for easy cleanup, no flare‑ups, and delicious results.
html:
When you want restaurant‑quality crispy chicken tenders without the mess of a deep fryer, a reusable grill mat is the secret weapon. By cooking crispy chicken tenders on a grill mat, you get that golden crust, juicy interior, and a grill that stays clean. Below is a step‑by‑step guide that works on any charcoal or gas grill, and it highlights why the BBQ Grill Mats are ideal for this job.

Why Use a Grill Mat for Chicken Tenders?

Grilling directly over flames can cause flare‑ups, especially when the meat releases juices. A grill mat creates a non‑stick surface that keeps the tenders from sticking while allowing the heat to circulate evenly. The result is a crisp, evenly browned exterior without the burnt spots you sometimes see on a bare grill. Because the mat is reusable, you also eliminate the waste of disposable foil or parchment.

Gather Your Ingredients and Tools

Before you fire up the grill, assemble the following items. Having everything ready makes the process smooth and prevents over‑cooking.

  1. 1 lb chicken tenderloins (or breast strips cut into 1‑inch pieces)
  2. 1 cup buttermilk (or a dairy‑free alternative)
  3. 1 cup all‑purpose flour
  4. ½ cup panko breadcrumbs
  5. ½ cup cornmeal
  6. 1 tsp paprika, ½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp onion powder, salt & pepper to taste
  7. Cooking spray or a brush of high‑smoke‑point oil
  8. BBQ Grill Mats
  9. Grill tongs, a shallow dish, and a wire rack for resting

Prep the Chicken and the Coating

Start by marinating the chicken. Place the tenderloins in a bowl and cover them with buttermilk. Let them sit for at least 30 minutes; this tenderizes the meat and helps the coating adhere.

While the chicken is soaking, combine flour, panko, cornmeal, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper in a separate shallow dish. Mix until the spices are evenly distributed.

Coat, Preheat, and Cook on a Grill Mat

When the chicken has marinated, pull a piece of the BBQ Grill Mats out of its roll and lay it on the preheated grill. Heat the grill to medium‑high (about 400‑425 °F). Lightly spray the mat with cooking spray or brush a thin layer of oil; this ensures an extra crisp surface.

Remove each tender from the buttermilk, letting excess drip off, then dredge it in the seasoned flour mixture. Press the coating onto the meat so it sticks well. Place the coated tenders directly onto the oiled grill mat. Because the mat prevents direct contact with the flame, you won’t have to worry about flare‑ups.

Cook the tenders for 3‑4 minutes per side, flipping only once. The mat’s even heat distribution gives a uniform golden crust while the interior reaches an internal temperature of 165 °F. If you notice the tenders browning too quickly, lower the grill temperature slightly; the mat helps regulate the heat.Once cooked, transfer the chicken tenders to a wire rack for a minute or two. This short rest lets excess oil drip off and keeps the crust crisp.

Finishing Touches and Serving Ideas

Serve the crispy chicken tenders hot, with your favorite dipping sauces—honey mustard, ranch, or a spicy sriracha mayo. For a complete meal, pair them with grilled vegetables, a simple coleslaw, or a side of sweet potato fries. The reusable grill mat also makes cleanup a breeze; just let it cool, wipe it down, and store it for the next grill session.

Tips for Perfect Results Every Time

  • Pat the chicken dry before coating to avoid a soggy crust.
  • Use panko breadcrumbs for extra crunch; they hold up better on the grill than regular breadcrumbs.
  • Don’t overcrowd the mat—give each tender enough space for the heat to circulate.
  • If you prefer a spicier bite, add a pinch of cayenne pepper to the coating mix.
  • After each use, clean the BBQ Grill Mats with warm, soapy water and let them air dry; they’re designed to last for many grilling seasons.

FAQ

Can I use the grill mat on a charcoal grill?

Yes. The BBQ Grill Mats are heat‑resistant up to 500 °F, making them suitable for both gas and charcoal grills. Just place the mat on the grill grates and preheat as you would normally.

Do I need to oil the grill mat?

While the mat is non‑stick, a light spray of cooking oil helps achieve an extra‑crisp exterior on the chicken tenders. A quick mist or brush is enough.

How do I store the grill mat after use?

Allow the mat to cool completely, then rinse it with warm water and a mild dish soap. Pat dry or let it air dry before rolling it up and storing it in a dry place. Proper care keeps the mat reusable for years.
